DeepSeek's instruct evals use thinking + reasoning_effort=100 -- set --dsv41-enable-thinking (DSV41_ENABLE_THINKING) + --dsv41-reasoning-effort to mirror them. The exported ids match the server byte-for-byte WITH BOS.
